result.brief: 提出人-机器人视频编辑套件，将人类操作视频转为动作一致、物理合理的机器人视频并恢复3D手部状态，构建14M帧数据集，为具身世界模型与机器人策略提供可扩展监督。
result.reason: Human-to-robot video editing with cross-embodiment motion adaptation and 3D hand-state decoding; provides scalable video supervision for robot learning, connecting to world-model/embodied video generation.
